fact: GUILAB's own page describes its operating data centre at the Centre Emetteur de Kipé, Conakry (228.91 m2, colocation room linked to a meet-me room) serving telecom operators, ISPs and other customers; the page carries no date, so as_of is its 2025 copyright year.

The national Data Center (600 m2, COREX) was officially launched on 4 September 2025, and the presidency's chief of cabinet said it is open to offering hosting services, including for other countries' data.

COREX's deputy director-general said the national Data Center is certified Tier 3 Design by Uptime Institute, with Tier 3 construction certification still to come; the article calls it the country's first Tier III data centre.
Data centres dataset: GUILAB Data Centre (GUILAB SA), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2020-10-01).
